course_description: Deals with computer network principles covering different layers, topologies and models of computer networks (explore Open System Interconnection), network programming, and network applications. This course also focuses on the TCP/IP protocol, network architecture (including implementation, administration and maintenance) and infrastructure design. Students also gain “hands-on” networking experience by installing and setting up a network operating system, building a small LAN, and expected to do systems/network programming and make use of simulation and measurement tools to gain an appreciation of current network design and performance issues.

course_learning_outcomes.text: explain the concept of network communication;
create a simulated network using Packet Tracer;
explain the principles of IPv4 and IPv6 address management;
configure initial settings on a network device;
describe data communications and network models, topologies, protocols, standards and architectures; and
explain how to use security best practices to mitigate attacks.
